bullets: Work with a Tier 1 mining client
content_text:
Kerman Contracting is seeking a Project Engineer to join our Site-Based Team. This role will see you coordinating all technical activities on assigned projects and participating in planning, scheduling, conducting, and coordinating Non-Process Infrastructure projects. 
This is an exciting opportunity to work on a brand-new project for a Tier 1 Mining client.
 Our Benefits on Offer:
 As a Project Engineer with Kerman, you will have the following benefits:
 - 18 months fixed term (potential to go longer) with leave accrual (Annual Leave and Sick Leave)
 - 2:1 FIFO roster from Perth 
 - Attractive Hourly Rate 
 - Attractive retention payment paid out on project completion
 - Salary sacrifice opportunities
 - Strong and diverse project pipeline 
 - Supportive team structure consisting of Head Office staff as well as site-based employees
 - Work on interesting projects for Tier 1 clients
 - Work on a project from mobilisation to commissioning 
 Your Roles, Duties and Responsibilities
 As a Project Engineer, you will:
 - Review drawings, plans, specifications, schedules and reports for projects, engineered systems, technical equipment or components and address design issues
 - Maintain the Project Quality Plan site systems
 - Assist in identifying changes in the scope of works and communicate these changes to the commercial team
 - Coordinate onsite inspection and testing activities
 - Coordinate MDR documentation onsite
 - Liaise with client quality representatives as required
 - Perform Quality checks on all completion documents from the contractors and staff
 - Maintain the NCR register and coordinate the responses to the client/subcontractors (external/internal NCRs) while ensuring corrective actions have been completed on time
 - Participate in periodic site quality audits
 - Regularly communicate with Perth Head Office on-site QA/QC issues/progress
 - Work with other disciplines to provide compliance with the contract requirements
 - Collaborate with clients, suppliers, head office engineers, consultants and contractors to resolve technical queries
 About you:
 To be successful for the Project Engineer role you will have:
 - Degree in Engineering, preferably civil or mechanical background
 - 3-5 years’ experience in a similar role, preferably within Construction
 - Experience in working with multiple discipline projects 
 - Experience with NPI or Non-Processed Infrastructure projects will be highly regarded
 About us:
 Kerman Contracting Pty Ltd (Kerman) is a successful West Australian company specialising in designing and constructing major industrial projects associated with Australia's Mining and agricultural sectors.
 We are committed to providing a safe, healthy, and productive work environment with a diverse and inclusive culture.
 Why choose Kerman’s for your next career step:
 - We are a stable Perth-based business with diverse and engaging projects to enhance your skills and experience in a positive working environment.
 - You are valued as an individual in an environment that does not allow for politics or toxicity on our sites or our Head Office in Applecross, Perth.
 - Work in an environment led by skilled, responsive, respectful, and supportive managers and be valued for your opinions and capabilities.
 If you are interested in the position at Kerman’s and believe your skills, personality, team-focused mentality, and experience align with the requirements mentioned, we encourage you to submit your application today.
